title: Boot crash after battery depletion (needs reflash)
description: Observed twice: if the watch battery fully depletes (hard power loss), the next boot crashes/doesn't complete. Device cannot be made to boot again unless the exact same firmware version is reflashed manually. Suspect power-loss corruption of settings/filesystem/bootloader state; need root cause + robust recovery (e.g., detect corruption and auto-reset/format).
notes: Also hardened external-flash file reads: Settings/Alarm/Bond restore now verify read length and delete corrupt files; Settings writes truncate; LVGL FS read now reports actual bytes read and errors on negative. These changes aim to prevent boot crashes from power-loss-corrupted littlefs files.

title: Host testbed: compute per-minute counts from accel txt
Graceful shutdown at 2% battery
description: Add immediate low-battery shutdown when battery <=2% and not charging. Shut down via SYSTEMOFF, wake only on charger. Sequence: disable BLE, flush motion log/storage, sleep display/peripherals, configure PowerPresent GPIO sense low, enter system off. No UI warning.
